derived_product: NASA OPERA Level-2 Radiometric Terrain Corrected SAR Backscatter (RTC-S1) Version 1
provider: NASA JPL OPERA / NASA ASF DAAC / modified Copernicus Sentinel data
coverage_note: OPERA RTC-S1 service coverage begins in October 2023. The runtime selects the latest raster intersecting each test center; it does not pretend to match the older optical acquisition date when that date predates OPERA RTC-S1.
scientific_caution: Preview luma statistics are display-space screening features. They are not calibrated sigma0/gamma0 backscatter values and must not be interpreted as soil moisture or channel presence without additional processing and validation.
